description: Returns the models the signed-in player owns, as their collection page keeps them, grouped by faction. Each entry's id and slug are the datasheet's, the same as list_units gives, with the models owned, how many are built and painted, and countsAs: other datasheets the player says those models can also be fielded as. A datasheet the current army data no longer has is named "A datasheet from earlier rules". Pass faction to read one army; a collection of more than 200 datasheets without one returns only each faction's totals. Requires mcp:read.

faction.description: Faction id, URL slug, or display name, as list_factions gives them.

name: get_my_collection
title: Read my model collection
